errors.text: The proposed getter is TiH2 within the alloy feedstock, whereas the target process uses titanium sponge as a separate oxygen getter.
The proposed argon treatment at 1200°C for 2 h substantially disagrees with vacuum sintering below 3×10^-6 torr at 1400°C for 18 h followed by quenching from 1500°C.
The hypothesis seeks oxygen below 0.8 wt.% and invokes TiO2 sequestration, while the target alloy deliberately retains approximately 1.0 wt.% oxygen for interstitial strengthening and phase control.
The mechanism predicts TiO2 formation but simultaneously predicts no TiO2 precipitates and proposes both monitoring TiO2 peaks and verifying their absence.
The predicted grain size of 1–5 μm is incompatible with the target post-quench grain size of 33 ± 19 μm.
